Subject: MedPath MAP: deployment playbook & region decision (hosted/dedicated/private)

Hi Emma / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Attached is a first-pass mutual action plan (MAP) that scopes the evaluation steps, procurement checkpoints, and proposed close timeline for the Fall quarter. High-level asks from your side: SOC2 evidence (we noted the security questionnaire items you flagged) and a final confirmation of the production region preference (US-East vs. EU-West).

Key sections in the attached MAP_v1:
- POC success criteria (latency, throughput, privacy controls)
- Deployment mode evaluation: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private — recommended experiments for each
- Timeline & decision gates (POC -> Procurement -> Go-live)
- Procurement list & DocuSign SOW placeholder

Request: can you review the MAP and the security request file and tell us by Fri 10/10 whether you want us to provision a Hosted trial environment or proceed to a Dedicated evaluation? If you prefer Private (on-prem/VPC) we’ll need to schedule a deeper infra kickoff and have procurement loop in early since timelines lengthen.

Attachments: MedPath_MAP_v1.xlsx, MedPath_Security_Request_2025.pdf

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Solutions (Mid-Market)
Redwood Inference

Kimberly —

Thanks for the MAP. Quick answers from our side:
- We want to move fast on a Hosted trial to validate latency and throughput against our clinical ingestion pipelines.
- However, compliance needs us to validate SOC2 artifacts before production, and we're considering Dedicated for our longer-term SLA needs.
- Region: US (primary), with a target of us-east for the POC.

Can you provision Hosted test credentials and a staging model instance in us-east by next Tue (10/14)? Also attaching a short list of security questions (we'll upload the full questionnaire to the portal).

Emma
